topic: Water drops make touchscreens tap themselves
hook: Your phone screen can tap itself when water sits on it.
title: Your Phone Screen Taps Itself With Water
description:
Water drops on a touchscreen can fool it into registering touches that nobody made. Capacitive screens sense electrical charge, and water changes that charge. Watch one drop on your screen, then wipe it dry.

#Shorts #Technology #PhoneTricks
comment_prompt: Has your screen ever ghost-tapped? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your phone screen can tap itself with water.
scenes.headline: SCREEN TAPS ITSELF

scenes.narration: Touchscreens sense electric charge, not pressure.
scenes.headline: CHARGE, NOT PRESSURE

scenes.narration: Water changes that charge, so it gets confused.
scenes.headline: WATER CONFUSES IT

scenes.narration: Apps open and letters type by themselves.

scenes.narration: Your screen taps itself, no finger needed. Tomorrow: a river that flows backwards.
scenes.headline: TOMORROW: BACKWARDS RIVER
